description: Defines the AWCContainerBase class, which inherits from BaseRefCount<IContainer> and provides methods for retrieving container ID, memory info, processor info, and network interfaces within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: AWCContainerBase
classes.description: A class inheriting from BaseRefCount<IContainer>, providing container identification and resource information methods.

methods.name: AWCContainerBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container with a given ID.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information associated with the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information for the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network interfaces of the container.
